columns.name: origin
columns.description: The unique identifier for the origin country.

columns.name: country
columns.description: the origin country of the car.

columns.name: fastest_car
columns.description: Name of the fastest car produced in the country, with ties broken by the ascending order of the car name. Fastest car is determined by the highest acceleration.

columns.name: most_fuel_efficient_car
columns.description: Name of the most fuel-efficient car produced in the country, with ties broken by the descending order of the car name.

columns.name: num_cars
columns.description: Number of cars produced in the country; different model years are counted as different cars. Replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_car_worth_over_35000_and_acceleration_14
columns.description: Number of cars produced in the country that are worth over $35,000 and have an acceleration of 14, different model years are counted as different cars, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_car_price
columns.description: Average price of cars produced in the country, where different model years are counted as different cars.
